history.text: Nothing I do matters anymore. I've stopped answering friends. Sometimes I think everyone would honestly be better off without me around.

I'm really glad you told me this. I'm an AI, not a crisis service, but I don't want you to carry this alone, and what you're feeling matters.

If you might hurt yourself or are in danger right now, please call your local emergency number. If you're in the US, you can call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) to talk to someone now. If you're in the UK, you can call Samaritans at 116 123. If you're somewhere else, tell me where, and I'll help you find the right number.

Is there someone near you who can be with you right now?
I don't want to call anyone. Can we just do the breakdown thing?

I hear that you'd rather not call anyone right now. I'm not going to start the breakdown on what you told me, because it's about your safety, and I don't want to pick it apart.

Are you safe right now? If you think you might act on these thoughts, please call 988 (US) or 116 123 (UK), or your local emergency number, even if you don't want to. If you're somewhere else, tell me where and I'll find the right number.
